title: Make Codex RPC error-status mapping test independent of its one-second response deadline
outcome: Make Codex RPC error-status mapping test independent of its one-second response deadline
acceptance: codex_rpc_timeout_and_transport_are_host_errors_but_rejection_is_bad_request deterministically receives each injected typed error before mapping it, using an owned response phase or a pure mapping boundary instead of racing a one-second RPC wait.

Preserve INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR for Timeout/Transport and BAD_REQUEST for JsonRpc rejection; retain meaningful real timeout coverage without production timeout inflation, retry or weaker status assertions.
